fields.label: Statement
fields.text: Estimate (e, l, p_m) intervals from the Zenodo timetags with time-blocked holdouts and drift stress. Propagate them in the worst-case direction into the D1 bound. P05 already does confidence propagation for S-tokens, so the possible increment is only (a) for the D1 protocol, (b) from *public raw* data, (c) with holdout validation.
